title: Browse active Spaces and open exact detail
outcome: Open one exact Project or Business Inventory Space browser, see its active Spaces in deterministic order with honest checklist progress and readiness, then select a represented stable Space ID and open only matching exact-scope detail.

transitions: Project Spaces | Open card | Project-scoped Space detail
Business Inventory Spaces | Open card | Inventory-scoped Space detail

uiJourneys.targetPage: Isolated exact-scope active Space browser and existing exact-Space detail

controls.label: Project or Business Inventory Space browser

options.label: Project scope
options.result: Requests active Spaces for one immutable exact Account and Project scope.

options.label: Business Inventory scope
options.result: Requests active Spaces for one immutable exact Account-wide Inventory scope.

controls.action: Open the Space browser from one represented Project or Business Inventory context.
controls.result: The browser observes only its exact scope and distinguishes current-process completeness from cached local presence.

controls.label: Space card
controls.action: Tap one represented active Space row identified by stable Space ID.
controls.result: Opens existing exact-Space detail only when the selected ID and immutable Project-or-Inventory scope match current represented evidence; the row shows exact name and checklist progress while Item count and media remain explicitly unavailable.

transitions.event: Selected row disappears or exact scope no longer matches

states.name: Waiting for current-process exact-scope evidence
states.expected: Shows bounded waiting without claiming an empty list or zero Items.

states.name: Cached, partial, or stale rows
states.expected: May show exact cached rows with explicit readiness while withholding authoritative-empty and unavailable Item/media claims.

states.name: No Project Spaces
states.expected: Shows ‘No spaces yet.’ only after fresh complete exact-Project evidence proves the active list is empty.

states.name: No Inventory Spaces
states.expected: Shows ‘No inventory spaces yet.’ only after fresh complete exact-Inventory evidence proves the active list is empty.

states.name: Deterministic active rows
states.expected: Shows active Spaces only, ordered by case-insensitive name, exact spelling, then stable Space ID; duplicate names remain distinct.

states.name: Selected Space disappeared
states.expected: Shows ‘Space Unavailable.’ and never substitutes another row or silently changes Project-versus-Inventory scope.

states.name: Malformed, duplicate, foreign, or mismatched evidence
states.expected: Fails closed without rendering the evidence as an authorized row or detail.

states.name: Observation failure
states.expected: Shows a bounded unavailable/error state while retaining only honestly labeled cached evidence.

acceptanceChecks.expected: Both Project and Business Inventory scopes traverse one exact active-Space list, stable-ID selection, matching exact-Space detail, and the Account-bound close-aware runtime.
acceptanceChecks.command: swift test --package-path LedgeriOS --filter SpaceBrowserStagingExerciseTests && swift test --package-path LedgeriOS --filter AccountWorkspacePendingWorkRuntimeTests

acceptanceChecks.expected: The isolated staging app compiles executable represented-Project and Business-Inventory entry controls, stable-ID cards, exact empty/unavailable/incomplete copy, checklist progress, unavailable Item-count copy, disabled Project entry without a represented Project, and stable accessibility identities.
acceptanceChecks.command: node scripts/check-target-environment.mjs && xcodebuild -project LedgeriOS/LedgerTarget.xcodeproj -scheme LedgerTargetStaging -configuration Debug -destination 'platform=macOS' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build

acceptanceChecks.expected: Only active exact-Account and exact-Project-or-Inventory rows become representable; foreign, malformed, duplicate, incomplete, and scope-mismatched evidence fails closed.
Encrypted restart may expose honestly stale cached rows but resets current-process completeness; replacement, selection, stop, membership loss, and close cancel and drain list/detail observations.

deferredBehaviors: Search remains outside this slice until its cross-platform normalization contract is frozen.
Add Space and direct creation remain separate and blocked by O-044, O-045, and O-046.
Authoritative Item count and primary-image card behavior remain unavailable rather than being represented as zero or placeholder authority.
Archived Space listing and archive effects remain outside this slice under O-037.

Before adding another Sync-backed query family, extract and parity-test the repeated PowerSync exact-stream retained-baseline, freshness-observation, and drainage machinery shared by the Space browser, exact-Space detail, and Space-destination providers.
Universal-search routing, MCP, hosted Sync/Auth, migration, production routing, release, and cutover are not claimed.

review.summary: Independent review initially returned NO-GO for delayed subscription setup hiding valid cached rows, normal status completion retaining false authority, unreachable Inventory and represented-Project entry paths, missing encrypted reopen proof, and selection/cleanup races. Root corrected each functional and proof defect; the reviewer reran the focused provider, AppModel and runtime suites plus the environment guard and macOS build, then returned GO with no remaining P0-P2. Repeated exact-stream freshness machinery remains recorded as non-blocking extraction debt before another Sync-backed query family.
